rendered: The Table row for Section 6[1] (Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes) names NMC 811[2] as the cathode. In the ORNL study the paper describes, that cathode, at an areal loading of 2.2 mA h/cm^2[3], maintaining 80% capacity at 6C charging rate[4]. The corresponding NMC 532[5] and NMC 622[6] cathodes, at a similar loading, only retained 49% and 56% capacity, respectively, at 6C rate[7], so that cathode kept substantially more capacity at the fast rate than either of them.
